exposure: Hospital volume of placenta accreta spectrum hysterectomy cases
cohort: Women aged 15-54 years with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent a hysterectomy during their delivery hospitalization in New York State from 2000 to 2017
finding: There was no difference in the adjusted rates of transfusion or surgical complications based on hospital volume, but the risk of severe maternal morbidity was reduced by 33% at intermediate volume centers compared to low-volume centers.
